notes.title: Demo Out Now !
notes.content:
Exciting news! The free demo of Bunny Hop Hop is now available on Steam!

[b]What's in the Demo:[/b]

[list]
[*] Play through a selection of vibrant, hand-crafted levels.
[*] Meet some of the adorable yet mischievous enemies.
[*] Get a taste of the  game mechanics and the hand-drawn art style.
[/list]

[b]What's Coming in the Full Game:[/b]

[list]
[*] Even more captivating levels to explore and conquer.
[*] Additional quirky enemies and fun obstacles.
[*] More weapons!
[*] Enhanced gameplay features based on your valuable feedback.
[/list]

Play the demo, add Bunny Hop Hop to your wishlist, and share your thoughts—we'd love your feedback to make the game even better.

Happy hopping!
